title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
The Opportunity We are an investment firm building a next-generation \"AI Operating System\" to power our deal flow and investor relations. We are looking for a Low-Code Engineer who can own our operations stack.


We aren't looking for someone to just connect simple triggers (Zapier-style). We need an architect who can build complex, multi-step workflows that fetch unstructured data (call transcripts, email history), process it via LLMs (Claude/GPT), and execute high-stakes communications with precision.


What You Will Build (General Scope)

  • AI-Driven Communications: Workflows that draft hyper-personalized emails to investors and clients by referencing historical data and context.
  • Intelligent Reporting Loops: Systems that periodically query our database to aggregate activity logs and generate strategic summaries for stakeholders.
  • Data Synchronization: Ensuring seamless data flow between our CRM (Attio), Database (Supabase), and Deal Room (Airtable).
  • Contextual RAG: Building logic that pulls specific past interactions (transcripts) to inform future AI outputs.

The Tech Stack

  • Orchestration: n8n (Primary requirement).
  • Database: Supabase (PostgreSQL).
  • CRM: Attio & Airtable.
  • AI: Anthropic (Claude 3.5 Sonnet) & OpenAI APIs.

Who You Are

  • n8n Expert: You are comfortable using Code Nodes (JavaScript) to manipulate JSON data, handle error routing, and manage complex logic trees.
  • Data Literate: You are comfortable writing SQL queries (Supabase) to fetch, filter, and aggregate specific datasets (e.g., \"Fetch interactions from the last 48 hours\").
  • Prompt Engineer: You understand how to structure System vs. User prompts to prevent hallucinations and ensure strict formatting compliance.
  • Detail Oriented: We automate high-value interactions. You understand the importance of testing and \"kill-switches\" to prevent errors.

title: Delivery Manager
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) Delivery Manager para liderar a execução de projetos de implantação de soluções AWS em clientes dos EUA. A posição exige experiência sólida em gestão de projetos de escopo fechado e híbrido, além de forte habilidade de comunicação em inglês (nível C1), para interação com stakeholders internacionais.


Responsabilidades

  • Gerenciar projetos complexos de curta duração (em média 3 meses), incluindo assessments, POCs e MVPs.
  • Conduzir implantações de projetos AWS em clientes dos EUA.
  • Liderar equipes multidisciplinares, garantindo alinhamento, motivação e produtividade.
  • Acompanhar e controlar cronogramas, escopo, riscos e entregas.
  • Realizar acompanhamento e controle financeiro dos projetos, garantindo saúde orçamentária e rentabilidade.
  • Manter relacionamento próximo com stakeholders e clientes, assegurando qualidade e satisfação nas entregas.
  • Aplicar práticas de gestão de projetos (de preferência com certificação PMP).


Requisitos

  • Inglês fluente (nível C1) – imprescindível.
  • Experiência comprovada na gestão de projetos complexos, preferencialmente de tecnologia e cloud.
  • Vivência em projetos de implantação de soluções AWS é um diferencial relevante.
  • Experiência em gestão de equipes e coordenação de recursos.
  • Conhecimento em metodologias de projetos híbridas (ágil e waterfall).
  • Certificação PMP (desejável).
  • Forte capacidade de organização, comunicação e resolução de problemas.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia em consultorias de tecnologia.
  • Atuação prévia em projetos internacionais


Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the AI/R Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Azure DevOps Engineer
description:
Title: Azure DevOps Engineer

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Type: Contrcat (PJ)


Job Description:

Azure DevOps, Azure Pipelines CICD SonarQube Git Kubernetes Docker Azure Keyvault Azure App Service Application Gateway, APIM Azure Cosmos DB, HDI Kafka Networking Infrastructure provisioning like ARM or Terraform Any scripting language, preferably Bash Python OpenShift jfrog

Experience

  • Min of 5-6 yrs in Cloud CICD preferably in Azure and the above skills


Job Description

  • Involves creating Azure YAML pipelines for CI/CD, including QGs to ensure the quality of code deployed
  • Should be well-versed with Git and SCM best practices
  • Set up the infrastructure on Azure as required by the Engineering team
  • Automate infrastructure provisioning and be able to integrate it to azure pipelines
  • Has to be well-versed in Kubernetes and all its features
  • Should be able to understand the functioning of an application and how it interacts with other services to help in troubleshooting issues
  • Should be able to write scripts to automate frequent tasks and integrate it with the required pipeline
  • Should be able to understand how an application is registered on AAD and interacts with the back end
  • Understand the concepts of data and event flow
  • Knowledge of ML and Lightbend Cloudflow is an added plus
  • Should be well-versed in Release and Deployment methodologies

title: U.S. Immigration Paralegal/Case Manager
description:
Company Description


Robinson Immigration Law is a boutique U.S. immigration law firm based in Nashville, Tennessee, serving clients across the United States and globally with 100% remote capability. The firm focuses on high-skill, business, and investment-based immigration, working with founders, executives, researchers, creatives, and investors looking to build their lives and careers in the U.S. With expertise in pathways such as EB-1A, EB-2 NIW, O-1A, and E-2, Robinson Immigration Law prioritizes thoughtful positioning and effective solutions to achieve durable immigration outcomes.


Role Description


This is a full-time, remote role for an Immigration Case Manager (Paralegal), with a focus on visas including the EB-1A, EB-2 NIW, O-1, and E-2.


The case manager will assist in immigration case preparation, including conducting legal research, drafting support letters, and completing immigration forms. Responsibilities include communicating with clients to gather necessary documents, providing updates on case status, and maintaining accurate and organized electronic filing systems. The role also involves calendaring deadlines, ensuring timely submissions, and collaborating directly with attorneys to ensure a smooth and efficient case process.


Qualifications


  • Strong legal research, case management, and document preparation skills
  • Experience in drafting professional correspondence and support letters
  • Excellent organizational, time management, and attention-to-detail capabilities
  • Well-developed communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to interact professionally with clients
  • Proficiency in legal or office software systems and tools
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment and manage multiple tasks or deadlines
  • Prior experience in immigration law, particularly with employment-based or investment-based visa processes, is highly preferred


We offer a supportive and collaborative team environment, competitive salary and vacation, and opportunities for learning and advancement.


We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Especialista de Middleware (Produção)
description:
Atividades:

  • Conduzir salas de War Room para resolução de causa raiz de problemas ligados a Produção, atuando diretamente no ambiente, organizando a linha de troubleshooting, fomentando possíveis soluções de correção definitivas e/ou alternativas, consolidando e comunicando o report para o cliente e gerência;
  • Identificar problemas relacionados a aplicação e suas camadas e arquitetura e solução (APACHE, Weblogic, Banco de Dados, Load Balance, Redes e etc) e suas integrações com sistemas de front end;
  • Resolução de problemas de alta complexidade e identificação de RCA;
  • Colaborar com a gestão de TI e controles internos na sustentação de sistemas, visando priorizar as principais TIRs (melhorias);
  • Fomentar e elaborar propostas para otimizar e automatizar processos operacionais a partir da análise de cuasa raiz dos eventos que afetam a Produção;
  • Analisar tendências de incidentes/problemas e propor soluções preventivas bem como a solução definitiva;
  • Propor automações e monitorações que antecipem cenários de problema;
  • Implantar soluções de IA, ML e automações que antecipem problemas e atuem na resolução de maneira, cada vez mais assertiva e rápida;
  • Instalação de upgrades, manutenção e monitoramento de sistemas/processos;
  • Análise de perdas e ganhos de KPI (Key Performance Indicator) dentro da área de produção;
  • Elaboração de IOPs (Instruções Operacionais) para resolver possíveis Gaps de projetos e melhorar experiência do cliente;
  • Análise de perda de SLA (Service Level Agreemente) por meio de PowerBI e e Banco de dados para fluxo de vendas, que impactam diretamente a experiência do cliente;
  • Monitoração dos ambientes de produção, através de ELK Stack, Grafana, Zabbix, Kibana;
  • Melhoria contínua do fluxo de produção em nível operacional, através de correções de problemas por INCs, BUGs e TIRs.
  • Disponibilidade de horário e escala 24x7.


Conhecimentos específicos:

  • Seja formado na área de exatas, preferivelmente sistemas de informação ou informática e afins;
  • Ótima capacidade de comunicação oratória e escrita, principalmente em cenários de WR;
  • Experiencia em ambientes com WebLogic, Containers Docker e Kubernets;
  • Experiencia em ambientes com banco de dados;
  • Experiencia em troubleshooting envolvendo camadas de infra como Redes, Balanceadores, Firewall;
  • Experiencia em manutenção de aplicações hospedadas em cloud;
  • Experiência em camada de observabilidade;
  • Experiência em ambiente UNIX/Linux e Windows;
  • Experiencia em suporte a aplicações de Billing, Ciclo de Receita, Ordering e Integrações;
  • Experiencia em análise de logs, mapeamento de ofensores e direcionamento de causas raiz;
  • Experiencia em operação de contratos com KPIs e SLAs;
  • Comunicação padrão Soap/Rest e análise de Json/XML;


Nossos benefícios:

  • Vale refeição;
  • Vale alimentação;
  • Vale combustível;
  • Plano de saúde;
  • Plano odontológico;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Auxílio Creche;
  • Auxílio crianças com deficiência;
  • Convênio Farmácia;
  • PLR;
  • TotalPass;
  • Integra (Programa Qualidade de Vida);
  • Trabalho Remoto ou Híbrido.
  • Apoio a certificações;
  • Day off no mês do seu aniversário;

title: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer (Python & AI/ML) – Full-Time, Remote
description:
Senior Software Engineer (Python & AI/ML)


Company: GTG LLC

Company Stage: Startup / Growth-Stage

Location: Remote

Experience Level: Senior (7+ years)


About the Role


GTG LLC is a growing startup building intelligent, scalable software solutions. We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer with deep expertise in Python and AI/ML engineering, who is also comfortable operating across the full stack.


This role is ideal for someone who enjoys ownership, moving fast, and solving complex technical problems in an early-stage environment. You will work closely with founders and key stakeholders to design, build, and scale backend systems, AI-driven services, and modern web applications.


Key Responsibilities


 - Design, develop, and maintain backend services using Python and frameworks such as Flask, Django, and FastAPI

 - Build and integrate AI/ML solutions, including model deployment, inference pipelines, and data processing workflows

 - Architect and maintain RESTful APIs with strong performance, scalability, and reliability

 - Collaborate on frontend development using modern JavaScript frameworks such as React, Next.js, Angular, or Vue

 - Contribute to overall system architecture, technical decisions, and engineering best practices

 - Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines to ensure reliable deployments and high code quality

 - Work across the full product lifecycle, from early design and prototyping to production support

 - Identify technical gaps and proactively propose and implement solutions


Required Qualifications


 - 7+ years of professional experience as a Software Engineer or similar senior-level role

 - C1 or higher English proficiency (mandatory) — strong verbal and written communication skills

 - Deep expertise in Python and backend development

 - Hands-on experience with Flask, Django, and/or FastAPI

 - Strong background in AI/ML engineering, including production-level model integration and deployment

 - Proficiency with modern JavaScript frameworks (React, Next.js, Angular, or Vue)

 - Cloud experience with AWS or Azure (required)

 - Experience with CI/CD pipelines, version control, and production deployment workflows

 - Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently in a fast-paced startup environment


Nice to Have


 - Experience with Java or C#, or proficiency in more than one backend programming language

 - Experience with GCP in addition to AWS or Azure

 - Prior experience working in early-stage or fast-moving startups


What We Offer


 - Opportunity to play a key technical role in a growing startup

 - High level of ownership and influence over architecture and product direction

 - Fully remote and flexible work environment

 - Competitive compensation, based on experience and skill level

title: Analista de implementação Bitrix24
description:
(IMPORTANTE: Já ter atuado com Bitrix24 e n8n são requisítos mínimos.)


Somos uma empresa pioneira em soluções tecnológicas que combinam implementações Bitrix24 com inteligência artificial avançada. Estamos na vanguarda da criação de agentes de IA e automações inteligentes que revolucionam processos empresariais. Nosso diferencial está no desenvolvimento de soluções personalizadas potencializadas por IA que transformam radicalmente a operação de nossos clientes, oferecendo eficiência e inovação através da combinação de Bitrix24, n8n e modelos avançados de linguagem (LLMs).


A Oportunidade

Estamos em busca de um talento que irá atuar majoritariamente em nossas implementações Bitrix24 e o auxiliar nos desenvolvimento soluções de IA, contribuindo diretamente para o crescimento da empresa em um momento crucial de expansão. Esta é sua chance de fazer parte de uma equipe inovadora que está na fronteira da tecnologia, criando agentes de IA personalizados e redefinindo o uso de ferramentas empresariais com inteligência artificial avançada.


Suas Responsabilidades:

Implementações Bitrix24 de Excelência

- Trabalhar diretamente com nossos clientes nas implementações Bitrix24

- Participar ativamente de calls para entendimento de projetos e requisitos

- Manter comunicação constante com os clientes durante todo o ciclo de implementação

- Desenvolver automações customizadas que transformam processos empresariais

- Realizar configurações e customizações avançadas na plataforma

- Fornecer suporte técnico especializado, garantindo a satisfação contínua dos clientes


Integrações Avançadas com n8n

- Criar fluxos de integração perfeitos entre sistemas de terceiros e o Bitrix24

- Utilizar o n8n como ferramenta principal para construção de integrações robustas

- Otimizar processos através de integrações entre múltiplas plataformas

- Possuir domínio da ferramenta para conseguir analisar e interpretar workflows já existentes


Será um diferencial se você:

- Construir agentes de IA inovadores utilizando LLMs através do n8n

- Desenvolver, testar e refinar prompts para aplicações de IA

- Implementar soluções de inteligência artificial que tragam resultados mensuráveis para nossos clientes


Crescimento Real

- Oportunidade de crescimento em uma empresa em expansão

- Potencial para assumir posições de liderança à medida que crescemos

- Participação ativa nas decisões estratégicas da empresa


Perfil Que Buscamos

Procuramos alguém que vista a camisa da empresa e tenha verdadeira \"dor de dono\". Como parte de um time enxuto e altamente colaborativo, você terá a oportunidade de participar ativamente de todas as atividades da empresa, contribuindo em múltiplas frentes e desenvolvendo uma visão completa do negócio.

Valorizamos profissionais com excelente comunicação e habilidade para construir relacionamentos de confiança com os clientes. Você atuará como o principal ponto de contato técnico, representando nossa empresa em reuniões, calls de alinhamento e apresentações de soluções, sendo fundamental sua capacidade de entender as necessidades dos clientes e transformá-las em implementações eficientes.


Faça Parte da Nossa História

Esta não é apenas uma vaga de trabalho – é uma oportunidade de fazer parte de algo especial desde o início. Se você é apaixonado por tecnologia, tem experiência com Bitrix24, n8n e está animado com as possibilidades da IA, queremos conhecer você!

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Na Conquest One, somos mais do que uma consultoria tecnológica: somos uma equipe movida pela paixão por inovação e pelo impacto positivo que geramos nos nossos clientes e colaboradores.

28 anos de história e 16x eleita uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar em tecnologia no Brasil (GPTW).

Desde 2021, também estamos presentes em Portugal!


Estamos em busca de um(a) SRE nível especialista para estar alocado em um dos nossos grandes clientes! Aquele profissional \"referência\", que resolve, estrutura e eleva o nível de confiabilidade de ambientes críticos e de alta disponibilidade em escala global.

Se você gosta de desafios reais, ambientes complexos, alta responsabilidade e impacto direto no negócio, essa vaga é para você!


Remoto – residindo no Brasil - 6 a 12 meses de duração

Atuação diária com time e stakeholders nos EUA

Garantir confiabilidade, escalabilidade e performance de sistemas críticos, atuando na ponte entre desenvolvimento e operações, aplicando princípios de engenharia de software para resolver desafios de infraestrutura e operação.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Location: Remote (Brazil)

Working Hours: 9am–5pm EST (some flexibility)

Openings: 3

Contract Duration: 8-month contract with potential extensions

Structure: CLT (non-negotiable)

Start Date: April 6th, 2026

Interview Process: 2 rounds!


Job Description

In this role, you will support infrastructure operations for a suite of software products by managing permissions, handling access requests via Slack, and troubleshooting one-off operational issues as they arise. You will assist with releases for new services and perform ongoing patching and maintenance across cloud infrastructure, primarily within an Amazon Linux environment. Using AWS services such as EC2 and Security Groups, along with Terraform for infrastructure as code, you will follow established configurations to build, modify, and maintain cloud resources. The role also requires writing scripts to support automation and deployment workflows, collaborating closely with engineering teams to ensure stable and secure operations. While the environment is mostly Linux-based, there may be occasional interaction with Windows systems, though this is secondary to the core responsibilities.


Required Skills & Experience

  • 3–5 years of professional experience as a DevOps Engineer
  • Strong AWS experience, including EC2, Security Groups, command line usage, and ECS Fargate
  • Experience with GitHub Actions and Jenkins (CI/CD pipelines, automation, etc.)
  • Hands-on Terraform experience — both command line and coding — to build cloud infrastructure, create/modify resources, and update security group permissions following existing patterns
  • Linux environment expertise: Amazon Linux, system maintenance, troubleshooting, and scripting for installation and deployment
  • Scripting & automation skills (Packer, Terraform, or Ansible preferred)
  • Strong critical thinking — must be able to take tickets and work independently without heavy guidance
  • Excellent communication and proactive updates; must know when to escalate or ask for help
  • Experience reviewing and remediating vulnerability and FinOps tickets (cost optimization, workload cleanup, etc.)


Nice to Have Skills & Experience

  • Windows experience


Compensation & Benefits

20,000-28,000 BRL per month

All CLT statutory benefits will apply for this position. Full benefits shared upon a video screening.

title: Casting Coordinator
description:
As Blueclip, we started our journey to bring the most creative minds and the know-how together to deliver great works.


About Our Search

We are currently looking for a Casting Coordinator to join our client, a global content company with a focus on talent sourcing for dynamic content projects.


What are we looking for?

  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field or equivalent experience.
  • 2+ years of experience in casting, story production, or talent interviewing.
  • Strong communication skills in English.
  • Proficiency with various casting resources and familiarity with social media platforms like TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and Twitch.
  • High attention to detail and the ability to work efficiently under tight deadlines.
  • Organized, self-motivated, and capable of handling multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
  • Positive attitude with flexibility to adapt to last-minute changes and cancellations.
  • Experience with casting databases and familiarity with Monday.com and Google Suite.


What will you do?

This role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to talent sourcing and casting across innovative content projects.


  • Identify and source emerging talent across social media platforms, staying on top of trends.
  • Post-casting calls aligned with creative outlines for new and ongoing productions.
  • Screen, organize, and categorize auditions, preparing submissions for producer review.
  • Coordinate auditions with talent, agencies, and managers, managing the talent booking process.
  • Maintain a robust casting database with accurate records and updated talent profiles.
  • Collaborate with Performance Managers to validate profiles, negotiate terms, and align schedules.
  • Produce and direct assigned content episodes, ensuring alignment with strategy, budget, and creative goals.
  • Hosting the episodes on Youtube, being on camera as an interviewer.
  • Build strong relationships with the talent to foster positive creative collaborations and ensure smooth productions.
  • Track deadlines, legal requirements, and production specifications for timely and cost-effective delivery.


Are you ready to make an impact in content creation? Apply now with your English CV !

Are you ready to make an impact in content creation? Apply now with your English CV !

We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.


With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.

  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;

  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;

  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV.

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: EOS Linux Server Manager (Inglês Avançado)
description:
LINUX SERVER MANAGER FOR ENHANCED OPERATIONS SERVICE


We are looking for professionals with extensive experience in Linux and Unix, and public Cloud, for support in Professional Services.

The ideal candidate has deep understanding of Cloud operations, being able to give L3 support, acting in a big team, dedicated to help clients. We need someone able to solve critical and high-impact issues independently.

A customer first mindset is a must.


• Participate in Major incident handling, troubleshoot service request failures, downtime extensions, long running ongoing incidents for a customer. (Level 3 support)

• Quick responses during escalations, take proactive steps to avoid escalations, identifying and driving initiatives to improve the operation and stability for our customer system

• Drive initiatives to standardize and simplify server operations.

• Continuous improvement methodologies: root cause analysis for Service requests failures/outages, performance issues

• Analyze root-causes of the failures (if known) in achieving the KPIS and define a corrective action plan, with well-defined mitigation steps.

• Coordinate and orchestrate the work between the various teams, collaborating with other units within and outside Enterprise Cloud Service units.

• Process improvement initiatives for daily operational activities

• Streamline standard operating procedures by focusing on automation enhancements.

• Proactive Operation services for the customer and service on-demand with timely alert reduction program to all the stakeholders involving the customer.

SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES

• Technically skilled in providing expert support for all Linux OS/Windows and Infra customer issues (Expert Linux Administrator).

• Strong experience in administration of our cloud platform based on Linux operating systems in Azure, AWS and Google Cloud as well as in SAP data centres.

• Pacemaker administration knowledge.

• Practical experience with OS operation, upgrades and security patching

• Networking experience with the suite of TCP/IP, IP routing, NAT, firewalls

• Experience with network services like DNS and LDAP and HTTP proxies

• Good understanding of IT security, OS hardening

• Experience in script programming (Shell, Perl, Python, Go) and with server automation tools (Ansible, CHEF)

• Experience with server operations in large environments and in public clouds.

• Experience in Problem Management, Root cause analysis methodologies

EDUCATION AND QUALIFICATIONS

• 8+ years of related professional experience

• Bachelor’s degree or higher (Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technologies Management)

• Good analytical and solution-oriented thinking

• Very good communication

• Experience of safeguarding customer relationship and strong customer service focus

• Fluency in English



We are digital changemakers – here to disrupt old ideas, blaze new trails, and help enterprises transform and scale at unparalleled speed.

The ideal candidate has deep understanding of Cloud operations, being able to give L3 support, acting in a big team, dedicated to help clients. We need someone able to solve critical and high-impact issues independently.

A customer first mindset is a must.


• Participate in Major incident handling, troubleshoot service request failures, downtime extensions, long running ongoing incidents for a customer. (Level 3 support)

• Quick responses during escalations, take proactive steps to avoid escalations, identifying and driving initiatives to improve the operation and stability for our customer system

• Drive initiatives to standardize and simplify server operations.

• Continuous improvement methodologies: root cause analysis for Service requests failures/outages, performance issues

• Analyze root-causes of the failures (if known) in achieving the KPIS and define a corrective action plan, with well-defined mitigation steps.

• Coordinate and orchestrate the work between the various teams, collaborating with other units within and outside Enterprise Cloud Service units.

• Process improvement initiatives for daily operational activities

• Streamline standard operating procedures by focusing on automation enhancements.

• Proactive Operation services for the customer and service on-demand with timely alert reduction program to all the stakeholders involving the customer.

SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES

• Technically skilled in providing expert support for all Linux OS/Windows and Infra customer issues (Expert Linux Administrator).

• Strong experience in administration of our cloud platform based on Linux operating systems in Azure, AWS and Google Cloud as well as in SAP data centres.

• Pacemaker administration knowledge.

• Practical experience with OS operation, upgrades and security patching

• Networking experience with the suite of TCP/IP, IP routing, NAT, firewalls

• Experience with network services like DNS and LDAP and HTTP proxies

• Good understanding of IT security, OS hardening

• Experience in script programming (Shell, Perl, Python, Go) and with server automation tools (Ansible, CHEF)

• Experience with server operations in large environments and in public clouds.

• Experience in Problem Management, Root cause analysis methodologies

EDUCATION AND QUALIFICATIONS

• 8+ years of related professional experience

• Bachelor’s degree or higher (Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technologies Management)

• Good analytical and solution-oriented thinking

• Very good communication

• Experience of safeguarding customer relationship and strong customer service focus

• Fluency in English



We are digital changemakers – here to disrupt old ideas, blaze new trails, and help enterprises transform and scale at unparalleled speed.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
*Please submit your CV in English only.


Location: Remote – based near Sao Paolo, Brazil


POSITION PURPOSE/MISSION:


As a Customer Success Manager, you serve as the vital connection between our company and our

customers. The primary goal of this role is to ensure that our clients reach their desired outcomes

through the successful use and adoption of our software solutions. By cultivating trusted relationships, proactively guiding clients, and offering expert support, you directly contribute to their satisfaction, loyalty, and long-term success. This role is essential to ensuring that our customers see measurable value, continue their partnership with us, and are well-positioned to expand their use of our offerings.


Your ability to manage customer expectations, resolve issues efficiently, and provide actionable insights will play a key part in building strong, ongoing relationships. This position also requires an in-depth understanding of SaaS solutions and insurance operations, as well as a collaborative mindset suited for working in a globally distributed, remote-first team environment.


This role will have secondary responsibilities to assist with pre-sales activities including but not limited to: gather, understand and translate customer’s technical requirements, bridge communications between technical and non-technical teams, assist or conduct product demos, create technical documentation, assist or complete RFP’s, support FRISS’ implementation teams & other potential duties.



DESCRIPTION OF ACTIVITIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:


  • Customer Relationship Management

Build and nurture strong, long-term relationships with customers by serving as their trusted

advisor. Regularly check in with key stakeholders to understand their experience and align on

expectations and needs.


  • Proactive Engagement

Maintain regular contact with customers through scheduled calls, emails, and success planning

sessions. Ensure that their goals are defined and met, anticipate challenges, and propose

proactive solutions to maximize satisfaction.


  • Performance Monitoring

Continuously monitor customer usage, health scores, and performance data to assess how the

product is delivering value. Use insights to identify areas of concern or opportunity and

intervene early when needed.


  • Product Enhancements

Collect feedback from customer interactions and communicate relevant insights to the product

development team. Help inform future product enhancements by representing the voice of the

customer.


  • Renewals and Upselling

Take ownership of contract renewals, maintaining strong relationships that support ongoing engagement. Identify and pursue upsell opportunities where additional features or services can deliver added value to the customer.


  • Customer Training

Support new customers during onboarding by guiding them through our processes and helping them become self-sufficient. Provide training and support to ensure they can use our software confidently and effectively.


  • Internal Collaboration

Work closely with the Professional Services & Sales team to ensure a seamless handover from pre-sale to post-sale. Provide background on customer expectations and align on strategy for long-term success. And other duties assigned.


JOB SKILLS:


Success in this role depends on both soft skills and the ability to operate effectively in a digital, global

environment.


Must Haves:

  • Insurance Expertise

Deep subject matter expertise in Insurance is a non-negotiable for this role. The CSM must be able to communicate with clients in their native language (insurance), understand their needs and deliver consultative insights aligned with FRISS’ product value


Language Skills

  • This role requires tri-lingual language skills:

Native-level Portuguese to serve clients in Brazil; fluent in Spanish to serve clients throughout LATAM; and professional working level in English to communicate within FRISS.


Nice to Haves:

  • Customer Focus and Engagement

You are passionate about helping customers succeed, and you consistently strive to understand

their needs and exceed their expectations.


  • Business & Analytical Insights

You understand how your customers operate and how to align our solutions with their business

objectives. You are analytically inclined and can demonstrate FRISS’ value through storytelling

and analytical insights.


  • Technical Proficiency

You are comfortable using CRM systems, customer success platforms, and other relevant SaaS tools to manage your workflow and customer data effectively. · Global Perspective You thrive in an international, remote-first work environment and can communicate and collaborate across geographies and cultures with ease.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Company: Fraud Deflect

Role: Mid-Level — Software Engineer

Language: Native/fluent English (resumes in English)


About the role

Build and migrate backend and integration code from PHP/JavaScript into Python services. You’ll work on business logic, APIs/integrations, and data access, with light Linux operations and a strong focus on clarity, communication, and asking the right questions.


Responsibilities

  • Migrate existing PHP + JavaScript functionality into Python services (maintain behavior, improve structure, add tests).
  • Implement backend features and business logic with solid programming fundamentals.
  • Write and maintain SQL queries (data access, reporting, validations).
  • Run/debug scripts and jobs on Linux servers (SSH, logs, scheduled executions).
  • Contribute to code reviews; surface failures/risks early and propose fixes.

Highlight Job of the week!


Job Title: Legal Specialist


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates : $880-$1,440 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates : $1,760-$2,880 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $11 - $18 depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.



Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.



Job Summary : The Legal Assistant will be responsible for providing comprehensive support to attorneys, performing legal research, drafting documents, and maintaining client files.


Job Tasks :


  • Legal Research and Documentation: Conduct legal research and prepare various legal documents.
  • Case Management : Manage and organize case files and documents.
  • Client Interaction: Communicate with clients for information gathering and updates.
  • Administrative Support: Handle clerical tasks, manage calendars, and answer phone calls.
  • Court Preparation: Help attorneys prepare for court by organizing documents and coordinating logistics.
  • Compliance and Reporting: Ensure legal compliance and assist in filing documents with courts.


Qualifications:


  • 1 year of related experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational abilities.
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Collaborative team spirit.
  • Commitment to confidentiality.
  • A quiet, private workspace.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Languages:


  • English mandatory
  • Portuguese mandatory

title: Senior Go Developer
description:
Senior Go Developer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


As a Senior Software Engineer Backend you will be part of a fast-paced, collaborative team developing our attack surface intelligence capabilities. You will be a critical contributor to the development and integration of reconnaissance technologies and products while also moving forward the state of engineering best practices in our cybersecurity platform. If you enjoy pivoting between different problems and meeting new challenges every day while developing solutions that are mission critical to the organization, this role is for you!

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Develop and integrate cybersecurity testing and analysis systems with best-in-class cybersecurity platform;
  • Build high-performance, resilient, scalable cloud-based software, microservices architecture and containers;
  • Take software through CI/CD all the way to production and own its quality and availability;
  • Utilize GCP platform to build and run highly-available software systems;
  • Identify and resolve performance issues across systems and components;
  • Collaborate on a cross-functional team, working with Product, Operations, and Platform Engineering;
  • Integrate monitoring and alerting capabilities with backend modules to allow proactive improvements to availability and response times;
  • Design, implement and deliver well-tested, scalable, highly available systems;
  • Own and ideate technical solutions for product requirements and user stories;
  • Actively engage and participate in design and code reviews;
  • Offer guidance and support to junior team members, encouraging and cultivating a culture of continuous learning within the team

Essential Skills


  • Experience in distributed-systems and backend software engineering;
  • Strong Golang Required;
  • Strong experience and understanding of microservices, REST API design, gRPC, unit testing, BDD testing;
  • Strong design skills required – UML is a bonus; exposure to Domain Driven Design desirable;
  • Experience with asynchronous messaging technologies such as Google PubSub, Kafka;
  • In depth knowledge of NoSQL and RDBMS technologies;
  • Strong experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Cloud Environments (GCP preferred);
  • Experience working on agile teams;
  • Experience developing scalable and observable microservice-based applications
  • Experience with GitOps and DevOps principles, practices and tools;
  • A proven ability to thrive in a collaborative environment involving different stakeholders and subject matter experts.


Highly Desirable Skills


  • Interest in security / penetration testing;
  • Interest in GenAI and LLM technologies.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: Representante Comercial (RCA) | Hunter Região Centro-Oeste
description:
Sobre a vaga


Mobiis

Modelo de trabalho: Remoto (com atuação externa na região)

Região Centro-Oeste



Sobre a vaga


Buscamos Representantes Comerciais (RCA) com forte perfil hunter , foco em prospecção ativa, abertura de mercado e fechamento de novos contratos , para expandir a presença da Mobiis em diferentes regiões do Brasil.

Este profissional será um dos principais vetores de crescimento da companhia , levando ao mercado o ecossistema SaaS da Mobiis — soluções que transformam desafios logísticos complexos em eficiência operacional, redução de custos e ganho de escala , com foco em receita recorrente (MRR) e serviços.


Missão da função


Atuar de forma estratégica e autônoma na prospecção e aquisição de novos clientes, construindo um pipeline saudável e previsível, convertendo oportunidades em contratos e fortalecendo a presença da Mobiis no mercado logístico.


Reporte e interfaces


  • Reporta-se a: Gerente de Vendas da Mobiis
  • Interage com: Pré-Vendas, Marketing, Customer Success e time Comercial Interno


Principais responsabilidades


Prospecção ativa e abertura de mercado (Hunter)


  • Prospectar novos clientes de forma ativa (outbound): embarcadores, operadores logísticos, indústrias, distribuidores e varejo.
  • Mapear contas-alvo, decisores e influenciadores na região de atuação.
  • Atuar por múltiplos canais: telefone, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, e-mail e visitas presenciais.
  • Construir, gerir e manter pipeline próprio, contínuo e previsível.


Venda consultiva e condução do ciclo comercial


  • Conduzir reuniões de diagnóstico aprofundado (AS-IS / TO-BE).
  • Identificar dores operacionais, gargalos logísticos e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Apresentar de forma consultiva as soluções do portfólio Mobiis.
  • Elaborar e conduzir propostas comerciais envolvendo MRR, implantação, integrações e serviços.


Negociação e fechamento


  • Conduzir negociações com autonomia, respeitando as políticas comerciais da Mobiis.
  • Atuar com forte foco em fechamento, previsibilidade e geração de nova receita.
  • Garantir transição estruturada do cliente para os times de Implantação e Customer Success após o fechamento.


Gestão comercial e inteligência de mercado


  • Manter organização do funil de vendas e reportes periódicos de pipeline e resultados.
  • Monitorar concorrência, práticas comerciais e tendências do mercado regional.
  • Reportar oportunidades, riscos e insights estratégicos à liderança comercial.
  • Identificar e desenvolver potenciais parcerias regionais.


Metas e indicadores (referência)


  • Novos contratos fechados (MRR e serviços).
  • Volume mensal de oportunidades qualificadas geradas.
  • Taxa de conversão e ticket médio.
  • Ciclo de vendas e previsibilidade do pipeline.
  • Metas definidas em conjunto com o Gerente de Vendas, considerando o potencial da região.


Requisitos obrigatórios


  • Experiência comprovada em vendas B2B outbound (perfil hunter).
  • Histórico consistente em abertura de novos clientes e desenvolvimento de mercado.
  • Vivência em vendas consultivas e negociação com decisores.
  • Perfil empreendedor, autônomo, disciplinado e orientado a resultados.
  • Excelente comunicação, organização e capacidade de autogestão.
  • Carro próprio e disponibilidade para deslocamentos e visitas comerciais.
  • Residência no polo regional de atuação ou proximidades.


Diferenciais (alto peso)


  • Conhecimento em soluções alinhadas ao portfólio da Mobiis, como:
  • TMS (Transportation Management System)
  • WMS (Warehouse Management System)
  • DMS (Delivery Management System)
  • YMS (Yard Management System)
  • Roteirização e otimização logística
  • Plataformas SaaS para logística, transporte e supply chain
  • Relacionamento ativo com embarcadores, operadores logísticos, indústrias ou distribuidores.
  • Experiência em vendas de software SaaS e contratos recorrentes (MRR).
  • Conhecimento de indicadores logísticos (OTIF, custo de frete, produtividade, nível de serviço).


Exclusividade e conflito de interesses


  • Não há exigência de exclusividade.
  • O RCA poderá representar outras empresas, desde que não concorrentes diretas ou indiretas da Mobiis.
  • Eventuais conflitos de interesse serão analisados previamente pela Mobiis.
  • Território de atuação definido para organização comercial e proteção de oportunidades.


Modelo de remuneração


  • Modelo comissionado , com comissões atrativas sobre:
  • Receita recorrente (MRR)
  • Serviços (implantação, integrações, projetos e upsell inicial)
  • Possibilidade de ganhos recorrentes enquanto os clientes permanecerem ativos.
  • Percentuais, regras e condições definidos em contrato de representação comercial.


Suporte da Mobiis


  • Onboarding comercial e técnico sobre portfólio, mercado e posicionamento.
  • Materiais de vendas, apresentações e apoio do time de Pré-Vendas.
  • Acompanhamento próximo do Gerente de Vendas.
  • Marca consolidada, soluções robustas e alto potencial de crescimento.

title: Customer Service Specialist
description:
Join the Virtual Latinos Community!


With over 5,000+ VA's hired that are part of our community and 2,500+ companies helped , Virtual Latinos stands out as the first American company connecting exceptional virtual professionals from Latin America with small businesses and entrepreneurs across the US, Canada, and beyond.


Within our community, 10+ new job positions become available every week, providing professionals like you with fantastic remote job opportunities. Ready to explore the possibilities?

Apply today and become part of a community where your skills shine and your career aspirations soar!


Highlight Job of the week!


Job Title: Customer Service Specialist


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-Time Monthly Rates : $840-$$1,400 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)

Full-Time Monthly Rates : $1,680-$2,800 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $10,5 - $17,5 depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.


Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the job position that you will apply for as it will be based on the schedule requested by the client. All our clients are in the U.S. and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.


Job Summary :


The Customer Service Specialist will be responsible for providing exceptional customer support, resolving inquiries and complaints, managing customer accounts, and ensuring a positive customer experience across all communication channels.


Job Tasks :

title: Talent Pool - Persons with Disabilities (Banco de Talentos - PcD)
description:
About Revolut


People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 70+ million customers get more from their money every day.


As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


Diversity is how we build better

Diversity at Revolut drives better ideas, bolder thinking, and a more inclusive future. We’re committed to increasing representation, especially for people with disabilities who remain underrepresented in tech. That means removing barriers, opening doors, and creating access to opportunity so everyone can contribute, grow, and shape what's next in finance.


Areas we commonly hire for in Brazil


  • Audit
  • Data Analysis
  • Engineering
  • Legal
  • Risk
  • Finance
  • FinCrime
  • Operations
  • Product
  • Recruitment
  • Tax


If you don’t see your area listed above but believe your profile could be a good fit for Revolut, you’re also welcome to apply.


This is a dedicated talent track to support the inclusion of professionals with disabilities.

We move fast and we move together. Real innovation starts with representation, and we’re building a team where different abilities and perspectives are welcomed and valued.


If you apply through this channel, our Talent Acquisition team will review your profile with care. When we find a potential fit with an open role, we’ll reach out to connect you with the next steps in our hiring process.


Who can apply through this channel?

We welcome professionals with disabilities to apply through this channel or any other open roles on our careers page. This is a proactive way for us to discover diverse talent. If your profile matches an open position, our team will reach out to guide you through the next steps in the hiring process.


Can I apply if I don’t identify as a person with a disability?

This channel is specifically designed to connect with talented professionals with disabilities who want to grow their careers with Revolut. If this doesn’t describe you, please check out the range of opportunities on our careers page.


Why is Revolut breaking barriers to hire persons with disabilities in Brazil?

Our Revoluters are our priority. That’s why in 2021 we launched our D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive everyday. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.


Does applying here mean I’m automatically part of the recruitment process?

When you apply through this platform, our team will carefully review every profile. If your skills and experience align with a current opportunity, we’ll reach out to invite you to the next stage of our hiring process.


What if I'm not based in São Paulo? Can I still apply?

Yes. Revolut is a remote-first company that hires talent across Brazil and beyond. Our recruitment and onboarding are designed to be fully remote, and we embrace flexible work arrangements tailored to the role and business needs.


What you’ll need

  • Fluency in English
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Great problem-solving skills
  • Experience in a fast-paced working environment
  • The ability to communicate confidently across all levels
  • A self-starter attitude
  • A solid sense of ownership and ability to work independently
  • High attention to detail


Nice to have

  • Fluency in other languages
  • Practical knowledge of Google Suite


Important notice for candidates:


Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles:

  • Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.


We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.


By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed, if applicable, any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn, or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed.

title: Human Resources Specialist
description:
Are you a talented Human Resources expet looking for an exciting new challenge? We are seeking a HR Specialist (preferred) from Brazil, with proven expertise in Human Resources, who is ready and willing to help us build a strong international team—either by working remotely from Brazil or by relocating to Croatia.

Key Requirements:

• Expert knowledge and experience in Human Resources (minimum 2–5 years preferred)

• Bachelor’s degree or higher in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field

• Fluency in English, Portuguese, and Spanish (written and spoken)

• Excellent communication and organizational skills

• Strong motivation to build a career in an international environment

What We Offer:

• Competitive average salary for HR specialists in Brazil: 6,500–7,750 BRL/month (approx. 1,020–1,215 EUR/month)

• Attractive monthly bonus: 5 EUR for every worker hired

• Additional retention bonus: 10 EUR for every worker who remains in Croatia for 6 months

• Monthly bonuses can reach around 1,000–2,000 EUR, depending on performance and hiring results

• Option to work remotely from Brazil or relocate to Croatia

• If you choose to work in Croatia: paid apartment provided

• Opportunity for professional growth in a dynamic, international team

• Support with relocation and integration in Europe

Key Responsibilities:

• Full-Cycle Recruitment: Manage the entire recruitment process for various roles, including drafting job descriptions, posting ads, sourcing and screening candidates, conducting interviews, and coordinating the hiring process with relevant departments.

• Onboarding & Integration: Organize and execute onboarding programs for new hires, ensuring a smooth transition into the company—whether they are working remotely from Brazil or relocating to Croatia.

• Employee Support: Serve as the main point of contact for employee questions and concerns, providing guidance on HR policies, benefits, and company procedures.

• Documentation & Compliance: Prepare and maintain accurate employee records, contracts, and documentation in compliance with Croatian and international labor laws.

• Performance Tracking: Monitor employee performance and retention, provide regular feedback to management, and support the implementation of performance improvement plans.

• Retention & Engagement: Develop and implement strategies to improve employee satisfaction and retention, including organizing team-building activities and wellness initiatives.

• Relocation Assistance: For employees relocating to Croatia, provide support with visa applications, travel arrangements, and settling into their new environment, including coordinating housing (paid apartment provided).

• Collaboration: Work closely with management and other departments to understand staffing needs and contribute to the development of HR policies and best practices.

• Reporting: Generate regular reports on recruitment, onboarding, and retention metrics, as well as bonus eligibility for hired and retained employees.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Role: Senior Software Engineer, Platform Reliability Operations

Location: LATAM (Remote)

Type: Contract

Bill Rate: DOE


Responsibilities:

  • Analyze and improve system design to reduce failure modes and promote self-healing systems
  • Establish and maintain robust systems that facilitate observability, encompassing logging, monitoring, distributed tracing, alerting, and offline test tools.
  • Work with development partners to shape the architecture, design, and implementations of new and existing systems to enhance their reliability, performance, efficiency, and scalability
  • Ability to work both independently as well as part of a geographically dispersed yet integrated team.
  • Collaborate with service engineers to establish Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Service Level Objectives (SLOs) for backend services.
  • Being able to identify the indications or cues that demonstrate the effectiveness of an application and having the knowledge to improve or repair its performance
  • Ability to assess options and suggest solutions when there is limited or unclear information. This position requires a level of comfort and assurance in dealing with uncertain situations.
  • Ability to work seamlessly within a team as well as manage individual tasks
  • Respond to emerging incidents, solve critical issues, and follow through with a plan for resolution or future mitigation
  • Act as an SME on the Engineering Operations team, partnering with backend services teams and application teams to overcome challenges across all the platforms where we stream our service


Required Skills:

  • 5+ years’ experience in software development
  • Degree in Computer Science or related or equivalent work experience
  • You have solid engineering and coding skills, data structure knowledge, and the ability to write high-performance production-quality code.
  • Experience building service-oriented APIs and cloud services
  • Experience designing, implementing, and deploying microservices
  • Extremely technical hands-on server software experience
  • Proficient in Golang, and JavaScript, and quick to learn new languages.
  • Experience in the Linux environment and a good understanding of its fundamentals and internals: filesystems and modern memory management, threads, and processes, the user/kernel-space divide, etc.
  • A good understanding of large-scale distributed systems in practice, including multi-tier architectures, application security, monitoring, and storage systems.
  • Working knowledge of the TCP/IP stack, internet routing, and load balancing.
  • Grit, drive, and a deep feeling of ownership.


Bonus Points for Experience with the following:

  • Golang
  • Typescript
  • Kubernetes
  • Terraform
  • Open telemetry
  • eBPF
  • Datadog
  • Helm Charts
  • HLS video transcoding, distribution & playback
  • Experience designing, implementing, and running services in high demand high-traffic environments
  • Experience with high-availability services

The Administrative Assistant will be responsible for providing administrative and customer service support, helping to coordinate schedules, maintain communication with internal and external teams, and manage tasks in a dynamic environment. The ideal candidate will be tech-savvy, detail-oriented, and proactive, supporting the client in a variety of tasks to ensure smooth daily operations.


Job Tasks:


  • Calendar Management: Organize schedules, book meetings, and keep calendars up to date.

  • General Admin: Assist with ad-hoc administrative and support tasks as assigned.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced environment.

  • Commitment to confidentiality.
  • A quiet, private workspace.

Software:

  • WhatsApp

  • Miro
  • Canva

title: Agentic AI Developer - Agentes de Inteligência Artificial
description:
Sobre a TRUTIME

A TRUTIME não está contratando um desenvolvedor.

Estamos abrindo espaço para alguém assumir controle de um sistema operacional de agentes autônomos , projetado para decidir e agir antes do mercado. Enquanto 99% das empresas ainda usam IA para responder quando alguém chama, nós fazemos o oposto.


Nossos agentes iniciam. Agem. Executam.


O problema que atacamos é brutalmente simples: Empresas perdem dinheiro porque demoram em responder., demoram para decidir, demoram para agir. E demora não escala.


A TRUTIME existe para substituir atraso por infraestrutura. Com código rodando em produção.


O que você vai construir aqui

Aqui você não vai “experimentar IA”. Você vai operar IA em ambiente real de negócio .

Na prática, você irá:

  • Construir agentes autônomos orientados a ação , (- conversa + ação)
  • Projetar sistemas right-time
  • Orquestrar agentes que operam 24/7 em canais reais (voz, WhatsApp, sistemas comerciais)
  • Definir arquitetura, limites de autonomia, fallback e controle de risco
  • Criar loops de decisão baseados em contexto, estado e prioridade
  • Ver seu código criar receita real , todos os dias


Na TRUTIME, seu código fala primeiro no mercado.


O NÍVEL:

O nível é alto e a responsabilidade também.

Autonomia é pré-requisito.


Se você é bom, isso vai te atrair. Se você é excelente, isso vai te incomodar, até você participar.


Depois de entender que tempo é a única vantagem que não pode ser copiada , trabalhar na construção de qualquer outro tipo de sistema operacional não vai fazer sentido.


A TRUTIME NÃO É PARA TODO MUNDO.

É para quem vai construir algo que o mercado ainda não sabe pedir.


Stack e Arquitetura (o que esperamos que você domine ou saiba decidir)

Atuando como especialista em agentic commerce , o stack esperado gira em torno de:


LINGUAGENS E RUNTIME

  • Python (core de agentes, decisão, orquestração)
  • Node.js (integrações, tempo real, pipelines de comunicação)
  • Experiência com ambientes assíncronos e concorrentes

LLMs e IA

  • Anthropic / OpenAI API ou equivalentes (LLMs como motores cognitivos)
  • Prompting estruturado + function calling + tool usage
  • State management para agentes (memória curta, média e longa)
  • Avaliação e observabilidade de agentes (não só accuracy)

AGENTIC SYSTEMS

  • Orquestração multi-agente
  • Definição clara de autonomia, limites e exceções
  • Sistemas orientados a eventos e decisão
  • Design de fallback humano e degradação controlada

INFRA

  • APIs REST e/ou WebSockets
  • Cloud (AWS)
  • Serverless quando fizer sentido. Stateful quando for necessário
  • Filas, jobs, retries, idempotência

DADOS E INTEGRAÇÕES

  • CRMs, ERPs, sistemas de vendas ou comunicação
  • Logs, métricas e rastreabilidade de decisão
  • Análise de performance baseada em impacto de negócio


O que diferencia um candidato forte

  • Já construiu algo que operou sem supervisão constante
  • Entende que agente bom não é o que “fala bonito”, é o que avança no pipeline de vendas
  • Consegue pensar arquitetura antes de código
  • Não tem apego dogmático a frameworks
  • Consegue discutir trade-offs entre velocidade, risco e impacto


Modelo de trabalho

  • Full-time
  • Remoto
  • Alta autonomia
  • Alta cobrança
  • Zero burocracia
  • Proximidade direta com estratégia de negócio.

title: Desenvolvedor Backend Node.js Sênior
description:
Quem somos

A DEXIAN, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como DEXIAN, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


*O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A DEXIAN está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!


O que estamos Buscando?

Desenvolvedor Back-End para participar da refatoração de demandas estruturais, com foco na revisão de processos e sistemas de integração e disponibilização de dados, desenvolvendo a solução tecnológica considerando escalabilidade, disponibilidade, segurança e monitoria. Atender as necessidades das áreas de negócios, observando os padrões e as diretivas corporativas. Disseminar conhecimento com seus pares, documentando, comunicando e viabilizando o acesso às informações. Ter atitude de dono, aplicando visão forense e buscando as melhores práticas com foco nos resultados e entregas. Levantar estimativas para as soluções propostas, com bom raciocínio lógico, senso crítico, organização, proatividade e boa capacidade de trabalhar em equipe.


O que você precisa ter:

• Experiência em ambientes de nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP) e desenvolvimento em NodeJs (JavaScript, desejável TypeScript), com testes unitários e de integração e documentação de APIs REST e Async API.

• Atuação no desenvolvimento de microsserviços, arquiteturas orientadas a serviços e eventos (SOA/EDA), com implementação de tracing, logging, containers e CI/CD.

• Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais, versionamento de código, NPM/Yarn e metodologias ágeis (Scrum e Kanban).

• Experiência em sustentação de aplicações, monitoria, troubleshooting, melhoria contínua e repasse para equipes de suporte.

• Diferencial para Java (Spring Boot e Spring Batch), Scala, Python, Kubernetes, mensageria (Kafka, RabbitMQ, Service Bus, SQS) e protocolos HTTP/HTTPS, AMQP e TCP.

• Vivência com segurança da informação (LGPD/GDPR), ambientes financeiros, SaaS/DaaS, integração de dados e ferramentas de transferência de arquivos.


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

• Atuação no desenvolvimento de microsserviços, arquiteturas orientadas a serviços e eventos (SOA/EDA), com implementação de tracing, logging, containers e CI/CD.

• Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais, versionamento de código, NPM/Yarn e metodologias ágeis (Scrum e Kanban).

• Experiência em sustentação de aplicações, monitoria, troubleshooting, melhoria contínua e repasse para equipes de suporte.

• Vivência com segurança da informação (LGPD/GDPR), ambientes financeiros, SaaS/DaaS, integração de dados e ferramentas de transferência de arquivos.


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

A DEXIAN, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. title: Remote Service Dispatcher (Fluent English) – US HVAC Company
description:
Company Description

Obie Comfort Solutions is a leading provider of high-quality heating, cooling, and air quality solutions. The company specializes in installing and maintaining a wide range of products, including boilers, furnaces, on-demand water heaters, and mini-splits. Known for delivering exceptional service, Obie Comfort Solutions supports customers with system design, installation, replacements, emergency services, and preventative maintenance. Their services are backed by industry-leading warranties and guarantees to ensure customer satisfaction.


Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for a Service Dispatcher with fluency in English. As a Service Dispatcher, you will be responsible for effectively scheduling and coordinating service calls, ensuring timely responses to customer requests. The role involves frequent communication with customers and technicians, troubleshooting service requests, and maintaining records for efficient operations. Providing excellent customer service and contributing to a seamless workflow will be key aspects of the position.


Qualifications

  • Proficiency in Dispatching and scheduling tasks to ensure timely service delivery
  • Strong Customer Service and Customer Satisfaction skills to build positive relationships with clients
  • Excellent Communication and Phone Etiquette skills to effectively interact with customers and team members
  • Detail-oriented mindset with the ability to prioritize tasks and multi-task in a fast-paced environment
  • Experience with HVAC systems or in a related service industry is a plus
  • Proficiency with scheduling or dispatch software is beneficial

title: Senior Java Developer - Relocation to Portugal
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • More than 10 years as a Back-End Developer with Java;
  • Experience with the latest versions of Java;
  • Solid experience with Spring Boot, Terraform, Kubernetes, Kafka, GraphQL and GitHub;
  • Work experience with Microsoft Cloud Azure;
  • Fluency in English (B2+) - Mandatory ;
  • Willing to move to Portugal with our support.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV.

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!



Personal Data collected by AUBAY PORTUGAL as Data Controller, regarding the identification, contact and professional capabilities of the candidates, in the present procedure, will be processed for the application analysis, having in consideration that the processing is conducted in order to to take the steps, at the request of the data subject, prior to entering into a contract;

Personal data sent through the present application will be kept by Aubay during the application procedure and will remain stored whilst updated (for two years period).

The collected data might be transferred or include other processing activities, as long as the data subject is informed, in the occurrence of a standard application and selection procedure, for the compliance of legal obligations for the time required by law.

title: Microsoft Dynamics Developer
description:
About You

You are a technically strong Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations Developer who enjoys building, customizing, and integrating enterprise-grade ERP solutions. You thrive in structured environments, value best practices, and take ownership of delivering reliable, well-documented systems. You collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and feel comfortable supporting, maintaining, and evolving complex business applications.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience).
  • Microsoft Certified: Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations Apps Developer Associate (mandatory and up to date, with annual renewal).
  • Strong experience developing and customizing Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (D365 F&O) solutions.
  • Solid understanding of D365 F&O architecture, development lifecycle, and best practices.
  • Proven experience designing and maintaining integrations using Azure Data Factory for ETL and data synchronization.
  • Hands-on experience using Microsoft Lifecycle Services (LCS) for deployment, monitoring, environment management, and maintenance.
  • Ability to collaborate with functional and technical stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills for production and non-production environments.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Develop, customize, and maintain Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations applications based on business requirements.
  • Design, build, and support data integrations using Azure Data Factory, ensuring data accuracy and reliability.
  • Use Microsoft Lifecycle Services (LCS) to manage deployments, monitor environments, and support application health.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (functional consultants, developers, business users) to deliver high-quality solutions.
  • Participate in code reviews and ensure adherence to development standards and best practices.
  • Provide technical support, troubleshooting, and issue resolution for D365 F&O applications.
  • Document technical designs, configurations, integrations, and operational processes.
  • Support ongoing maintenance, optimization, and continuous improvement of D365 F&O solutions.


Additional Information

About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.
